title: Grateful Dead Live at The Centrum on 1985-11-04
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: Strong, full‑sound audience recording with solid audio quality
ai_review.review: Reviewers praise the Sennheiser microphones and describe the sound as strong and full, indicating a good-quality audience source. No comments were made about the musical performance itself, so the show’s musical merit cannot be assessed from this review.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review focused on recording quality, rating it 4 stars and highlighting strong sound; lack of any performance commentary limits confidence in overall show rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Strong full‑sound noted; reviewers love the Sennheiser mics from the 80s/90s, indicating clear and robust audio despite being an audience source.
